snippet.title: The Botanist and the Translator - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Solve a planet-spanning plant mystery as the interstellar botanist Hatti and her trusty translator, Oliver! Investigate a lush, natural world and befriend a cast of crazy creatures in this breezy, beautiful adventure. Currently in development with the proud support of Team Cherry Presents.

Creator introduction: https://youtu.be/OlJGAjJf5xU
Wishlist on Steam: https://botanistandtranslator.com/
